ExpiryDate.name: Expiry Date
ExpiryDate.definition: Original expiry date of the reported financial instrument. ||Usage:|Field applies to derivatives with defined expiry date.

PriceMultiplier.name: Price Multiplier
PriceMultiplier.definition: Number of units of the underlying instrument represented by a single derivative contract.||For a future or option on an index, the amount per index point.

UnderlyingInstrument.name: Underlying Instrument
UnderlyingInstrument.definition: Choice to specify the type(s) of underlying instrument(s) that make up the financial instrument.

OptionType.name: Option Type
OptionType.definition: Specifies whether it is a call option (right to purchase a specific underlying asset) or a put option (right to sell a specific underlying asset).

StrikePrice.name: Strike Price
StrikePrice.definition: Predetermined price at which the holder will have to buy or sell the underlying instrument.

OptionExerciseStyle.name: Option Exercise Style
OptionExerciseStyle.definition: Indication as to whether the option may be exercised only at a fixed date (European, and Asian style), a series of pre-specified dates (Bermudan) or at any time during the life of the contract (American style). This field does not have to be populated for ISIN instruments.

DeliveryType.name: Delivery Type
DeliveryType.definition: Indicates whether the transaction is settled physically or in cash.

AssetClassSpecificAttributes.name: Asset Class Specific Attributes
AssetClassSpecificAttributes.definition: Specific attributes of the underlying asset class of the financial instrument.

MultiplierRule.definition: Price Multiplier must not be zero.
